snippet.title: 33 Immortals - Steam Trailer (ESRB)
snippet.description:
The wait is almost over: 33 Immortals is launching soon on Steam!

33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Play a damned soul rebelling against God's final judgment. Jump into epic 33-player co-op battles with instant matchmaking. Collaborate with allies to survive waves of monsters and defeat colossal bosses. Enhance your abilities with powerful relics and permanent upgrades. Face the ultimate challenge in a fight for your eternal life.

This trailer captures some of the game’s strongest moments and gives you a first look at the co-op battles, the raids, and the fight that awaits the damned.

Join the rebellion and Wishlisht 33 Immortals on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/958520/33_Immortals/ 

Sign up to our mailing list for the latest updates: https://thunderlotusgames.com/games/33-immortals/#gameSignup
